verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a list-assets endpoint that returns CAIP-19 identifiers, which encode both the asset and its chain, and it claims support for 100+ cryptocurrencies. That gives developers a programmatic way to discover supported assets. However, nothing in the pack names USDC, USDT or any specific network. Missing for 10: a published list naming USDC/USDT and peer stablecoins, named supported chains per stablecoin, and independent corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform documents which stablecoins and chains it supports — USDC, USDT and peers across multiple named networks — so I can match what my customers actually hold
